selection: Largest strictly positive grid speed with every swept obstacle clearance lower bound >=0.02 m and corridor lower bound >0 over the entire horizon; no grid refinement
control: One constant (v,-0.4) command chosen at B51 independently for each prescribed horizon, never updated; H2-selected command also checked on its H1 prefix
zero_speed_grid_note: (0,-0.4) rotates in place and is excluded from moving feasible-speed selection; (0,0) is separate trivial reference
decision_inputs: B51 original PD command and current validity
fixed static and already-spawned dynamic geometry
validation_only: Compare H1 RAW51 against recorded 72Hz pose and swept clearance after speed decisions are fixed
meaning: offline oracle geometry feasibility; grid maximum is not a continuous optimum
